hero.titre: A world without gender-based violence. Together, towards recovery.
hero.texte: In Congo-Brazzaville, Primrose listens to and supports women affected by violence, and works to make that violence recede — in families, schools, health services and all the way into the law.

missions.titre: Acting before, during and after violence
missions.texte: Preventing violence before it happens, supporting those who face it, changing the law and training those who receive survivors.

aide.texte: Confidential support, no sign-up and no trace left on your device.

vision.titre: No one should face violence alone.
vision.texte: A woman who dares to speak should find dignified listening at every door she knocks on: her family, the hospital, the police station, the court. That is what we are building, guided by our values.

engager.texte: Sisterhood means standing by one another. Here are the ways to do it with us.

prevenir.description: Organize large-scale campaigns, workshops and conferences to educate the general public.
prevenir.detail: We meet the general public where they are — schools, neighborhoods, media — to reduce gender-based violence before it happens, through information and dialogue.

soutenir.description: Provide psychological, medical and legal support to survivors.
soutenir.detail: Every survivor we support receives confidential listening and guidance toward the psychological, medical and legal resources suited to their situation.
actions: Referral to psychological and medical support

plaider.description: Advocate for legislative change and public policy against violence.
plaider.detail: We carry survivors' voices to institutions to advance Congolese laws and public policy against gender-based violence.

former.description: Train professionals (doctors, police officers, etc.) responsible for supporting survivors.
former.detail: Doctors, police officers and social workers are trained to receive survivors with dignity, so every intake matches what they are going through.

items.question: Will my personal information stay confidential?
items.reponse: Yes. Your data is protected and only accessible to authorized team members, in line with our privacy policy.

items.question: Do I need prior experience to volunteer?
items.reponse: No prior experience is required. Training and support are provided to every volunteer based on their role.

items.question: How can my organization become a partner?
items.reponse: Describe your organization and the kind of collaboration you have in mind in the form; our team will get back to you to discuss it.

items.question: Can I make a one-time donation instead of becoming a member?
items.reponse: Yes. Choose the "Donor" profile and share your preferences in the form; we'll follow up with the details.

aPropos.histoireTexte: Primrose – La Sororité Active was born from the belief that a world without gender-based violence is possible. In Congo-Brazzaville, we act every day along four complementary areas — prevent, support, advocate, train — so that prevention, listening and support are accessible to everyone who needs them.

politiqueConfidentialite.intro: This page explains what data Primrose – La Sororité Active collects through this site, why, and how it is protected. This site's audience can be in a vulnerable situation: confidentiality is not a formality, it is a safety requirement.

responsable.texte: [Association's legal name], [legal form], [registered address] — to be completed by the association before going live.

donnees.texte: Depending on the form used, we collect: name, email, phone (optional), city, message or motivation. For the "Need help" form: preferred contact method, a contact detail, an optional message and the urgency level — nothing more is asked.
donnees.aide: Contact details and messages submitted via "Need help" are encrypted as soon as they are saved (AES-256) and are never readable in plain text in our database, including by us: only an explicit, logged consultation by an authorized team member can decrypt them.

finalite.texte: Solely to respond to your request (membership, contact, training registration, help request) and to follow up on it. No data is sold, rented, or used for advertising.

conservation.texte: Data is kept for as long as needed to process your request, then until it is closed. [Precise duration to be defined by the association depending on the type of request, e.g. 3 years for routine exchanges.]

destinataires.texte: Only authorized team members (admin and super-admin roles) can view requests; help requests are restricted to admins and every consultation is logged. Our technical subprocessors: Supabase (data hosting), Resend (email delivery), Cloudflare Turnstile (anti-spam protection) — each operates under its own privacy commitments.

cookies.texte: A single technical cookie remembers your chosen language. If you accept it via the banner, Plausible (cookieless, no personal data analytics) may be enabled — never on the "Need help" page, which remains strictly free of any tracker, including any local storage on your device.

droits.texte: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data by writing to [contact email to be completed].

securite.texte: Encrypted connection (HTTPS), database-level access rules, additional encryption for help requests, security headers (CSP, HSTS) across the whole site.
